line: **Cations:** **positively charged ions** formed when an atom **loses electrons**, typically from **metals** (Na⁺, Ca²⁺); anions are negative ions formed by gaining electrons, typically from non-metals (Cl⁻).
**Actinides:** **radioactive** metallic elements – e.g. **uranium, thorium, plutonium** – used in **nuclear energy and weapons**.
**Molarity:** moles of solute per **litre of solution**; unit **mol/L**.
**Molality:** moles of solute per **kilogram of solvent**; unit **mol/kg** (molarity is per litre of solution).

mcq.s: The number of moles of solute per kilogram of solvent is called:
mcq.x: Molality = moles of solute / mass of solvent in kg (mol/kg); molarity is per litre of solution.

line: **Oberth effect:** an engine burn gives the **maximum gain when made at the highest-speed point** (perigee); lunar-mission orbit raising used repeated **perigee burns**, each raising the apogee, to save fuel.
**Akatsuki:** **Japan's Venus** mission (Europe's Venus mission: **Venus Express**).

line: **Somatic embryogenesis:** in plant tissue culture, **embryos develop directly from callus cells or explant (somatic) tissue**; in organogenesis, a **cytokinin-dominant** medium induces shoots and an **auxin-dominant** one roots.

**Phytochemicals:** a subset of **secondary metabolites** – naturally occurring plant compounds that give **colour, flavour and disease resistance**; **non-nutritive** but often **health-promoting** in humans.

**Biopiling:** **ex-situ** bioremediation – contaminated soil is **excavated and heaped into piles (biopiles)**; aeration, moisture and nutrients are controlled so **indigenous microbes** degrade pollutants (mainly **hydrocarbons**).

mcq.s: Biopiling, in which contaminated soil is excavated and heaped into aerated piles for microbes to degrade hydrocarbons, is a/an:
mcq.x: The soil is excavated and treated away from its original site, so biopiling is ex-situ bioremediation.

line: **Bioleaching:** using microorganisms (mainly **acidophilic bacteria and archaea**) to **dissolve metals out of ores, mine tailings or e-waste** – the microbes oxidise sulphides or ferrous iron, creating acidic conditions.
**Khukri class:** Indian Navy **corvettes** of **Project 25** (mostly decommissioned); **Kora class = Project 25A** (in service); Kamorta class = Project 28.
**Nanocoatings in textiles:** make fabrics **water- and stain-repellent**; **silver nanoparticles** in fabrics give **antimicrobial** (odour-free) textiles.
**Decryption:** converting **ciphertext back into plaintext** using a cryptographic algorithm and the **correct key**; done by authorised users (encryption is the reverse).

**Quantum key distribution (QKD):** bits are sent as **polarised photons** (via optical fibre or satellite); sender and receiver compare a small part of the data – any **discrepancy reveals eavesdropping**; if none, a secure key is generated.
**Fischer–Tropsch (FT) diesel:** a **2G biofuel** – liquid hydrocarbon fuels (synthetic diesel, kerosene) made by **biomass gasification**.
**Autograft:** transplantation of tissue **within the same individual** (skin grafts; coronary bypass using one's own vessels) – **no risk of immune rejection**.

mcq.s: A skin graft taken from one part of a patient's body and placed on another part of the same body is called:
mcq.x: Autograft = transplant within the same individual, so there is no immune rejection.

line: **Geotropism:** growth in response to **gravity** – shoots grow up, **roots grow down**; also phototropism (light), hydrotropism (water), chemotropism (chemicals), **thigmotropism** (touch – climbing plants, tendrils).
